reviews.review: Great game.  Great story and graphics.   Good end to the trilogy.   Maybe more space games are yet to come with this kind of story.

Normally, I try to go into detail when writing a review for a game.
Normally, I try to keep an open mind when writing these reviews...

But holy hell, EA... Why do they make their games such a CHORE to play?  Why do they half-arse these ports?
No native controller support, requires EA Origin AND Steam to play (If you buy on Steam).  Riddled with bugs, you have to hack your pc in order to get the games to run even when your system meets the specs required to play.
Played this game for 40 hours on pc, at least a 3rd of this time has gone into adjusting settings and getting the game to run so it is playable.
Don't get me wrong, I love the mass effect series.  It's fun... when I can play the game.

Stuff like this is why EA is consistently one of the worst game companies out there.  If it weren't for the fact that they keep swallowing up beloved franchises, they'd have gone under already.

If you don't mind troubleshooting and searching "why won't my game start up", then go ahead and get the game cause it is a great game.  Just be prepared for frustration in trying to get the game to actually run.

Game is outstanding, the full version as seen here is just top notch. 


Even the disappointment that was expressed with the original release was undeserved. I thought it was clever how it turned the indoctrination element shown in the earlier two games and sincerely trick the player into cooperating with the reapers. 
There is only one end-game option in which Shepherd wakes up and continues the fight. The other two options were the same choices made by the villains of the first two games respectively. It was a fairly clean-cut ending in that respect with the exception of us not knowing how the war with the reapers ended. 

That said, I would recommend playing the entire series, multiple times.
